protocol.prompt_source: tests/skill-evals/cases.yaml; prompt strings were copied verbatim into each runner task, and runners did not read the case file.
protocol.independence_scope: Control, treatment, and evaluator were separate Codex collaboration tasks in one recorded session.
audit_limitations: Runner identities and retrieval paths are self-reported from task context; they are not platform-signed execution logs.
The exact deployed model revision and sampling configuration were not exposed to the runners.
Stochastic outputs are not expected to reproduce byte-for-byte; hashes bind the committed artifacts actually assessed.
Treatment retrieval used a shared batch context, so path coverage is auditable but a distinct read event per case is not established.
CI validates artifact structure, hashes, paths, evidence excerpts, and arithmetic; it does not invoke a model or regenerate outputs.
protocol.post_run_annotation: Run IDs and manifest links were added above the raw case sections after collection; case response bodies were not rewritten.

skill_snapshot.note: This commit contains the bundle content available to the final treatment runner.
